svg.title: Under the hood: modern algorithms × a modern compiled language
svg.desc: Under the hood: modern algorithms × a modern compiled language. Algorithms, all built and in use today: Morsel-driven parallelism (each core owns a block, no barriers); Radix-partitioned hash joins (built in parallel without atomics); Parallel radix sort and select (percentiles and sorts on every core); HyperLogLog-sized hash sets (count distinct at 1M groups); Bounded top-k heaps (ORDER BY … LIMIT without a full sort); SIMD bulk Parquet decode (a column written in place, every core in a row group); Two-phase parallel dictionaries (text codes in file order, found in parallel); Planner from exact statistics (dense or hashed, heap or sort; EXPLAIN says why); Reproducible float sums (the same bits on any core count). Mojo: compiled ahead of time to native code; SIMD types and compile-time specialisation; no garbage collector; the same kernels on CPU and GPU. Python's ease with C++'s speed, in one codebase.
